messages.subject: question about igraph package
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to work with some network structures in R and use igraph package. I'm mainly interested in dynamic aspects of my networks, so I start with an initial network and then do a lot of add.vertices and add.edges operations.
now, here is my problem:
in one of my networks my edges are in fact weighted edges. when I "add" an edge I want that if there is no existing edge between the given nodes, then a new edge with the given weight will be added. However, if there is already an edge between the given nodes, I don't want a new (parallel) edge to be created, but rather, I want that the new weight will be added to the existing weight.

I don't know how to do that.
any suggestions?

thanks,

amit
